mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id userId,product_detail_id skuId,quantity,request_id requestId,status, COALESCE(expires_at <= NOW(),FALSE) expired FROM `order` WHERE order_number=#{orderNumber} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status=#{status},gmt_modified=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='WAIT_BUYER_PAY'
mapper.select: SELECT order_number FROM `order` WHERE status='WAIT_BUYER_PAY' AND expires_at <= NOW() AND request_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expires_at,id LIMIT 100
